s.t: Henny Penny lived on a farm.
s.fr: Henny Penny vivait dans une ferme.

s.t: One day, she stood under a tree.
s.fr: Un jour, elle se tenait sous un arbre.

s.t: An acorn fell from the tree.
s.fr: Un gland tomba de l’arbre.

s.t: It hit her on the head.
s.fr: Il la frappa sur la tête.

s.t: She did not see it fall.
s.fr: Elle ne le vit pas tomber.

paras.summary: Henny Penny lives on a farm, and one day while she stands under a tree, an acorn falls and hits her on the head, though she does not see it fall.

s.t: "Oh no!" cried Henny Penny.
s.fr: « Oh non ! » s’écria Henny Penny.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" she said.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit-elle.

s.t: "I must tell the king!"
s.fr: « Je dois prévenir le roi ! »

s.t: Henny Penny ran off the farm.
s.fr: Henny Penny quitta la ferme en courant.

paras.summary: She cries out that the sky is falling, says she must tell the king, and runs off the farm.

s.t: Henny Penny walked down a road.
s.fr: Henny Penny marcha sur un chemin.

s.t: Soon she saw a rooster.
s.fr: Bientôt elle aperçut un coq.

s.t: His name was Cocky Locky.
s.fr: Il s’appelait Cocky Locky.

s.t: "Where are you going?" asked Cocky Locky.
s.fr: « Où vas-tu ? » demanda Cocky Locky.

paras.summary: Henny Penny walks down a road and meets a rooster named Cocky Locky, who asks where she is going.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" said Henny Penny.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit Henny Penny.

s.t: "I must tell the king," she said.
s.fr: « Je dois le dire au roi, » dit-elle.

s.t: "I will come with you," said Cocky Locky.
s.fr: « Je viendrai avec vous, » dit Cocky Locky.

s.t: Henny Penny and Cocky Locky walked on together.
s.fr: Henny Penny et Cocky Locky marchèrent ensemble.

s.t: They wanted to find the king.
s.fr: Ils voulaient trouver le roi.

paras.summary: She tells him the sky is falling and she must tell the king, so Cocky Locky joins her and they walk on together to find him.

chapterList.title: Ducky Lucky and Goosey Loosey Join

s.t: Soon they came to a small pond.
s.fr: Bientôt ils arrivèrent à un petit étang.

s.t: A duck named Ducky Lucky stood by the water.
s.fr: Un canard nommé Ducky Lucky se tenait près de l’eau.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" said Henny Penny.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit Henny Penny.

s.t: "We must tell the king," Cocky Locky told Ducky Lucky.
s.fr: « Nous devons le dire au roi, » dit Cocky Locky à Ducky Lucky.

s.t: "I will come with you," said Ducky Lucky.
s.fr: « Je viendrai avec vous, » dit Ducky Lucky.

s.t: The three birds walked down the road.
s.fr: Les trois oiseaux marchèrent sur la route.

paras.summary: They reach a small pond, where a duck named Ducky Lucky hears that the sky is falling and joins them on the road.

s.t: They came to a green field next.
s.fr: Ils arrivèrent ensuite dans un champ vert.

s.t: A goose named Goosey Loosey looked up.
s.fr: Une oie nommée Goosey Loosey leva les yeux.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" Ducky Lucky told Goosey Loosey.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit Ducky Lucky à Goosey Loosey.

s.t: "We must tell the king," said Henny Penny.
s.fr: « Nous devons prévenir le roi, » dit Henny Penny.

s.t: "I will come too," cried Goosey Loosey.
s.fr: « Je viendrai aussi, » cria Goosey Loosey.

s.t: Four birds now walked on together.
s.fr: Les quatre oiseaux marchèrent maintenant ensemble.

paras.summary: The three birds reach a green field, where a goose named Goosey Loosey hears the same news and joins the group.

s.t: The four birds came to a barn.
s.fr: Les quatre oiseaux arrivèrent à une grange.

s.t: A big bird named Turkey Lurkey was there.
s.fr: Un grand oiseau nommé Turkey Lurkey était là.

s.t: "Where are you going?" asked Turkey Lurkey.
s.fr: « Où allez-vous ? » demanda Turkey Lurkey.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" said Henny Penny.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit Henny Penny.

s.t: "We must tell the king," said Cocky Locky.
s.fr: « Nous devons prévenir le roi, » dit Cocky Locky.

paras.summary: The four birds come to a barn, where a big bird named Turkey Lurkey asks where they are going.

s.t: "I will come too," said Turkey Lurkey.
s.fr: « Je viendrai aussi, » dit Turkey Lurkey.

s.t: The birds walked on together.
s.fr: Les oiseaux continuèrent à marcher ensemble.

s.t: They wanted to find the king.
s.fr: Ils voulaient trouver le roi.

s.t: The road led through the woods.
s.fr: La route traversait les bois.

paras.summary: They tell him the sky is falling and they must tell the king, so Turkey Lurkey joins them, and the road leads them on through the woods.

chapterList.title: Foxy Loxy and the Short Way

s.t: The five birds walked into the woods.
s.fr: Les cinq oiseaux entrèrent dans les bois.

s.t: Foxy Loxy saw them from the woods.
s.fr: Foxy Loxy les vit depuis les bois.

s.t: He came out to them.
s.fr: Il sortit vers eux.

s.t: "Where are you going?" asked Foxy Loxy.
s.fr: « Où allez-vous ? » demanda Foxy Loxy.

s.t: "We must tell the king," said Cocky Locky.
s.fr: « Nous devons avertir le roi », dit Cocky Locky.

s.t: "The sky is falling!" said Turkey Lurkey.
s.fr: « Le ciel tombe ! » dit Turkey Lurkey.

paras.summary: The five birds walk into the woods, where Foxy Loxy sees them and comes out to ask where they are going, and they tell him they must reach the king.

s.t: "I know a short way," said Foxy Loxy.
s.fr: « Je connais un chemin court », dit Foxy Loxy.

s.t: "Follow me through the woods," he said.
s.fr: « Suivez-moi dans les bois », dit-il.

s.t: But the short way led to his den.
s.fr: Mais le chemin court menait à son repaire.

s.t: The birds did not know this.
s.fr: Les oiseaux ne savaient pas cela.

s.t: They followed Foxy Loxy off the road.
s.fr: Ils suivirent Foxy Loxy hors de la route.

s.t: Foxy Loxy led them deep into the woods.
s.fr: Foxy Loxy les conduisit loin dans les bois.

paras.summary: Foxy Loxy says he knows a short way and leads them off the road, though the birds do not know his short way goes to his den.

s.t: They came to a big den.
s.fr: Ils arrivèrent à un grand terrier.

s.t: "This den is the short way," said Foxy Loxy.
s.fr: « Ce terrier est le chemin court, » dit Foxy Loxy.

s.t: "It leads to the king's home."
s.fr: « Il mène à la maison du roi. »

s.t: "Only one bird can go at a time."
s.fr: « Un seul oiseau peut y aller à la fois. »

s.t: "Go in, and I will follow," said Foxy Loxy.
s.fr: « Entrez, et je vous suivrai, » dit Foxy Loxy.

paras.summary: They find a big den, and Foxy Loxy says it leads to the king's home, though only one bird can go in at a time.

s.t: Cocky Locky went in first.
s.fr: Cocky Locky entra en premier.

s.t: He did not come out.
s.fr: Il ne sortit pas.

s.t: Ducky Lucky went in next.
s.fr: Ducky Lucky entra ensuite.

s.t: She did not come out.
s.fr: Elle ne sortit pas.

s.t: Goosey Loosey went in too.
s.fr: Goosey Loosey entra aussi.

s.t: She did not come out at all.
s.fr: Elle ne sortit pas du tout.

s.t: Only Turkey Lurkey and Henny Penny stood outside.
s.fr: Seuls Turkey Lurkey et Henny Penny restèrent dehors.

paras.summary: Cocky Locky, Ducky Lucky, and Goosey Loosey each go into the den one after another, and none of them comes back out, leaving only Turkey Lurkey and Henny Penny outside.

s.t: Turkey Lurkey went into the den next.
s.fr: Turkey Lurkey entra ensuite dans le repaire.

s.t: He never came out of it.
s.fr: Il n’en sortit jamais.

s.t: Henny Penny stood outside.
s.fr: Henny Penny resta dehors.

s.t: She heard a noise from inside.
s.fr: Elle entendit un bruit venant de l’intérieur.

s.t: The noise scared Henny Penny.
s.fr: Le bruit effraya Henny Penny.

paras.summary: Turkey Lurkey goes into the den next and never comes out, leaving Henny Penny alone outside, and a noise from inside scares her.

s.t: She did not go inside.
s.fr: Elle n’entra pas.

s.t: Henny Penny ran all the way home.
s.fr: Henny Penny courut tout le long du chemin jusqu’à chez elle.

s.t: She never found the king.
s.fr: Elle ne trouva jamais le roi.

s.t: She never told him about the sky.
s.fr: Elle ne lui parla jamais du ciel.

s.t: But Henny Penny was safe at home.
s.fr: Mais Henny Penny était en sécurité chez elle.

paras.summary: She does not go inside, and instead runs all the way home, and though she never finds the king or tells him about the sky, she is safe at home.
